name: parentSysId
label: Parent Sys ID
description: Sys_id of the parent record containing the playbook.

name: parentTable
label: Parent table
description: Table name of the parent record containing the playbook.

name: playbookExperienceId
label: Playbook experience
description: The playbook experience that the playbook should use.

name: resolvedPlaybookContexts
label: Resolved Playbooks Contexts
description: Pre-fetched playbook contexts data object.

name: compactMode
label: Compact mode
description: Display this playbook in compact mode for smaller UIs

name: activityView
label: Activity view
description: The activity view determines how activities are displayed in the playbook. Stacked shows all activities for a lane in the work area. Focused shows all activities for a lane in the playbook navigation and one activity at a time in the work area. Guided shows all completed activities in an accordion along with the current activity in the work area.

name: loading
label: loading
description: Show or hide loading indicator for playbook.

name: recordGeneratorQuery
label: Query
description: Encoded query string to optionally override the query provided for a record generator.

name: selectedPlaybookContextId
label: Selected playbook context ID
description: The current playbook that should be selected.

name: onlyShowSelectedPlaybook
label: Only show selected playbook
description: Boolean to determine if only the selected playbook should be shown.

name: selectedLaneContextId
label: Selected stage context ID
description: The current stage that should be selected.

name: selectedActivityContextId
label: Selected activity context ID
description: The current activity that should be selected.

name: loadingActivities
label: Loading activities
description: A map of loading activities. Determine what activities should be shown in a loading state.

name: playbookContextIdsInOrder
label: Playbook context IDs in order
description: An array of playbookContextIds. Determines the order of playbooks shown in the view.

name: playbooksByContextId
label: Playbooks by context ID
description: A map of playbooks using the context id of each playbook as the key.

name: selectedItem
label: Selected item
description: Selected playbook item.

name: userSession
label: User session
description: Contains current user session data.

name: parentRecordUpdateTime
label: Parent record update time
description: A Unix timestamp of when the playbook's parent record has been updated.

name: optionalActivityInsertionContext
label: Optional activity insertion context
description: Contains info for optional activity insertion mode.

name: optionalActivityTriggerContext
label: Optional activity trigger context
description: Contains info for adding optional activity triggers.

name: updatedActivities
label: Updated activities
description: Contains last updated activities.

name: flattenedActivities
label: Activities
description: Array of activities within all stages flattened

name: dataBrokerBlob
label: Data broker blob
description: A JSON Blob that contains any input properties so they can be selectable.

name: modalContexts
label: Modal Contexts
description: A JSON object containing relevant properties for playbook modals.

name: stagePickerVisible
label: Stage Picker visible
description: Show or hide stage picker.

name: formUiDomain
label: Form UI Domain
description: Domain value object of selected domain.

name: formFields
label: Form Fields
description: Form fields data.

name: nowDsDomainId
label: Domain ID
description: Domain ID for domain separation.

name: nowDsDomainScope
label: Domain Scope
description: Domain scope for domain separation.

name: nowDsRecordId
label: Record ID
description: Record ID for domain separation.

name: nowDsRecordTable
label: Record Table
description: Record table for domain separation.

name: actionLayoutId
label: Action Layout
description: Choose action config ID first. Then, optionally, you may choose to tie the action bar to a specific UX form action layout. If left blank, this will be dynamic.

name: extraParams
label: Extra Parameters
description: A JSON object containing properties for the activity ui.

name: forceCompactMode
label: Force Compact mode
description: Force this playbook to be in compact mode

name: hasParentRecord
label: Has parent record
description: Boolean property indicating has parent record

name: processDefinition
label: Playbook to launch
description: Process Definition to launch

name: overrideInputs
label: Override inputs
description: Override inputs within playbook

name: playbookExecutionId
label: Standalone execution
description: Standalone execution
